body.statement:
For \(T\ge3\), write
\[
A_\beta=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta},
\qquad
A_{\mathrm{iid}}=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sp}}.
\]
Then \(R_{\star,\beta}=A_\beta\vee R_{\mathrm{don}}\) and \(R_\star=A_{\mathrm{iid}}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}}\).  On every fixed nonempty class with \(B>D^2\), these are respectively the sharp conditional mean-squared-error rates under design-only geometric beta mixing and conditional calendar independence, and their square roots are the sharp uniformly honest expected-length rates.  Thus the oracle/generated-center boundaries are respectively
\[
N\asymp A_\beta^{-1/\kappa}
\qquad\text{and}\qquad
N\asymp A_{\mathrm{iid}}^{-1/\kappa}.
\]
At \(B=D^2\), both expressions remain valid upper phase maps, but neither theorem asserts a universal donor converse.  Conditional calendar independence therefore removes exactly the logarithm in the spacing component; it introduces no deconvolution or moving-Gram term.
body.proof_tex:
The exact algebra in \texttt{thm:oracle-generated-phase} gives
\[
R_{\star,\beta}=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sp},\beta}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}},
\qquad
R_\star=R_{\mathrm{tr}}\vee R_{\mathrm{sp}}\vee R_{\mathrm{don}}
\]
for \(T\ge3\).  The beta-mixing sharp-risk and honest-length claims are \texttt{thm:sharp-joint-frontier} and \texttt{thm:honest-length-frontier}; their iid analogues are \texttt{thm:iid-sharp-joint-frontier} and \texttt{thm:iid-honest-length-frontier}.  These four theorems convert the algebraic equalities into sharp statistical statements under fixed strict donor slack and give the stated boundary-envelope qualifications.  Finally, because \(R_{\mathrm{don}}=N^{-\kappa}\) and \(A_\beta,A_{\mathrm{iid}}>0\), equality of donor and oracle scales is equivalent to the two displayed formulas for \(N\).  Exact training coordinates exclude a measurement-error convolution, and the two exhaustive maxima contain no other term.  This proves the dependence elbow.
body.justification: The established algebra is combined with the beta and iid statistical frontiers.
body.gap: The fixed-query predecessor alone did not supply this complete causal-panel lift.
body.consumer: Analysts can distinguish the weak-dependence log-spacing boundary from the iid no-log boundary.
